definitions.explanation: A form on which an applicant declares facts the other party must know, above all the health declaration filled in when applying for life or medical insurance. Hiding or misstating facts on it can void the policy.
An official document informing someone of an obligation or decision, such as a tax-payment notice from a tax office or a notice of a traffic penalty.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{告知|こくち}→告知：17348_kokuchi⟧ (notification; disclosure) + ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (document). In everyday life learners meet it mostly in insurance applications, where the duty to disclose one's health is called {告知義務|こくちぎむ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {告知書|こくちしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit the declaration form
- {告知書|こくちしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in the declaration form
- ⟦{納税|のうぜい}→納税：13806_nouzei⟧{告知書|こくちしょ}: tax-payment notice
- {告知書|こくちしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: a notice arrives

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通知書|つうちしょ}→通知書：23842_tsuuchisho⟧: notice — the general word for any written notification
- {申告書|しんこくしょ}: tax return; declaration — a form one files with an authority, not one sent by it
